reader_summary.headline: Marcia Page is the Co-Founder and Executive Chair of Värde Partners and Founder and CEO of MPowered Capital.
reader_summary.overview: Marcia Page is the Co-Founder and Executive Chair of Värde Partners and Founder and CEO of MPowered Capital. Värde is a thirty-year-old $13 billion leading global alternatives firm specializing in credit. MPowered came out of Marcia's personal investing and focuses on accelerating equity for best-in-class female and underrepresented talent through capital, commitment, and connections.

key_points.text: Marcia is one of the few women to have founded and scaled an alternatives firm over three decades.
Our conversation spans Marcia's extensive career.
We discuss her Minnesota roots, early days at Cargill, founding and scaling of Värde, value investing, and transition of leadership at the firm.
